info.name: Aceolution Finance API
info.description:
# Aceolution Finance API — Documentation SOP

Kept in sync with Swagger (`/api/docs`). Generated by `npm run postman:generate`.

## How & Why
Each **folder** description explains Why / How / When to use those APIs.
Full guide (flow, roles, statuses) is at the top of Swagger `/api/docs`.

Flow: Microsoft / Demo Access / Login (password) → optional select-workspace → Catalogs → Submit expense (duplicate checks) → Approve → Partial pay / Pay → Notifications.

## Responses
Success bodies are returned as-is (no envelope). Errors:
```json
{ "statusCode": 400, "message": "Cannot approve expense. Current status is PROCESSED", "error": "Bad Request" }
```

## Saved Examples on each request
| Example | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| **200 / 201** | Body you get back |
| **400 Bad Request** | Business rule / missing field / wrong status |
| **401 Unauthorized** | Missing or invalid Bearer token (or wrong password on Login) |
| **403 Forbidden** | Signed in but role / project not allowed |
| **404 Not Found** | Where applicable |
| **409 Conflict** | Duplicate name / email |

## Variables
**Share for Teams / FE:** attach **only** `Aceolution-Finance.postman_collection.json` (one file).
Collection already includes `baseUrl` and tokens — **no environment file required**.

### Switch Local ↔ Azure (same collection)
Postman → Collection → **Variables** → edit `baseUrl`:

| Target | `baseUrl` value |
|--------|-----------------|
| Local | `http://localhost:3001` |
| Azure (live) | `https://ace-finance-api-f5hnhhd6c3bvffhj.southindia-01.azurewebsites.net` |

Then run **Authentication → Login** — pick an account from the Login saved examples (Admin / Requester / Approver / Processor).

| Variable | Purpose |
|----------|---------|
| `baseUrl` | API root (change this for Local vs Azure) |
| `accessToken` | JWT — saved by Login / Demo Access / Select workspace / Verify 2FA |
| `challengeToken` / `otpCode` | 2FA accounts: login saves the challenge, you type the code |
| `workspaceToken` | Dual-store accounts: login/Microsoft → Select workspace (`store` live|demo) |
| `expenseId` | Saved by Submit expense (or first row of List expenses) |
| `receiptFileName` | Saved after a payment / when an expense has receipts |
| `userId` / `projectId` / `categoryId` / `countryId` / `notificationId` | Saved by Create / List Tests scripts |

Swagger: `{{baseUrl}}/api/docs`

item.name: Authentication
item.description:
**Why:** Get a JWT for protected APIs and manage 2FA / passwords. **How:** POST /auth/login → (2FA accounts) POST /auth/verify-2fa → Authorize with access_token.
**When:** First request every session.

request.description:
**Why:** See if Microsoft Entra login is configured on this API.

**How:** GET → `{ configured, ... }`. Browser SSO uses `GET /auth/microsoft/login` (302).

**Why:** Dynamic personas for the login Demo Access picker (demo DB only).

**How:** GET → `[{ id, name, email, role, assignedProjects }]`. Toggle isDemo in Demo workspace → Users.

**Why:** One-click training login into the **demo** store (isolated Mongo + blobs).

**How:** POST `{ email }` (password optional) → JWT `store: "demo"`. Prefer this over password for @acefinance.com personas.

exec: if (res.challengeToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('challengeToken', res.challengeToken); console.log('2FA required: set otpCode, then run Verify 2FA'); }
if (res.workspaceToken) { pm.collectionVariables.set('workspaceToken', res.workspaceToken); console.log('Workspace choice: set store=live|demo, then run Select workspace'); }

request.description:
**Why:** Password path (admin / no Microsoft). Microsoft-linked and Demo Access personas are blocked here.

**How:** Send `{ email, password }` → Tests script saves `accessToken`. 2FA → `challengeToken` → **Verify 2FA**. Dual-store → `workspaceToken` → **Select workspace**.

Saved examples: Admin, Requester GAC, Approver Media, Processor Alisha (prefer Demo Access login for training personas).

item.name: Expenses
item.description:
**Why:** The expense request lifecycle — submit, track, approve, pay. **How:** POST /expenses (multipart) → PATCH approve → PATCH partial-pay / process (multipart receipt).
**When:** Request form, dashboard, approver and processor actions. Hard duplicates auto-block; potential duplicates need duplicateConfirmed=true.

request.description:
**Why:** Same rules as submit: hard block (file/invoice #) vs potential warning (project+category+amount ±1 day).

**How:** GET query → `{ isHardDuplicate, isPotentialDuplicate, ... }`. Rejected expenses are excluded.

response.name: 200 Hard duplicate
200 Potential duplicate

formdata.description: [Optional] Display name (JWT is source of truth)
[Ignored] Requester email is taken from the Bearer JWT
[Required] PDF / JPG / PNG / WEBP / GIF, max 5 MB — click "Select Files"

request.description:
**Why:** Requester raises a new expense with its invoice.

**How:** Authorize as REQUESTER → pick a file for `invoice` → Send. Tests script saves `expenseId`. Approvers of the project are emailed.

**Hard duplicate** (same file / invoice #) → 400, request not created. **Potential duplicate** → 400 `POTENTIAL_DUPLICATE:…` unless `duplicateConfirmed=true`. Use **Check duplicate** first.
